siteWebhook.title: Webhooks
siteWebhook.description: Manage outbound webhooks fired when content is published, unpublished, or deleted.
siteWebhook.blankDescription: Create a webhook to notify external systems (e.g. trigger a static-site rebuild) when content changes.
siteWebhook.generalDesc: Basic information about the webhook target.
siteWebhook.scopeDesc: Limit which site and which events trigger this webhook.
siteWebhook.name: Name
siteWebhook.urlHint: The endpoint a signed POST is sent to on each matching event.
siteWebhook.siteHint: Choose a single site to scope this webhook, or All sites for a catch-all subscription.
siteWebhook.eventsHint: When on, this webhook fires on every content event. Turn off to pick specific events.
siteWebhook.eventsDesc: Select which content lifecycle events trigger this webhook.
siteWebhook.secretDesc: The HMAC-SHA256 secret signing each payload. Auto-generated when left blank on creation.
siteWebhook.secretHint: Set this same value as SHIO_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the receiver to verify the signature.
siteWebhook.enabledHint: Disable to pause delivery without deleting the webhook.
